Cookies on our website

Essential cookies
These are necessary for core functionality and cannot be disabled. They include security and network management.
Analytics cookies
We use these to understand how visitors interact with our website, helping us find areas for improvement.
Marketing & Video cookies
Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant ads and enable video content from providers like YouTube.

<style>
/* Default Body/Content Font: Rubik */
body, body *, p, span, div, a, li, input, button, select, textarea, section, pre, code {
    font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Headings Font: Poppins */
html body h1, html body h2, html body h3, html body h4, html body h5, html body h6,
html body h1 *, html body h2 *, html body h3 *, html body h4 *, html body h5 *, html body h6 *,
html body [class*="heading"], html body .heading, html body .title,
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
h1 *, h2 *, h3 *, h4 *, h5 *, h6 *,
[class*="heading"], .heading, .title {
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif !important;
}
.custom-select {
    position: relative;
}

.custom-select select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 60px 10px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: #555;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* Slanted area */
.custom-select::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 3px;
    right: 3px;
    width: 64px;
    height: calc(100% - 6px);
    background: #f0f0f0;

    clip-path: polygon(25% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);

    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Arrow */
.custom-select::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: 22px;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    border-right: 3px solid #666;
    border-bottom: 3px solid #666;
    transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
}
  
/* Quantity Selector Styling */
.qty-selector {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    height: 40px;
    position: relative;
    background: #ffffff;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
}
.qty-minus {
    background: #dadada;
    width: 45px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #475569;
    user-select: none;
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 75% 100%, 0 100%);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
}
.qty-minus:hover {
    background: #e2e8f0;
}
.item-qty {
    flex: 1;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1e293b;
    background: #ffffff;
    margin-left: -11.25px;
    margin-right: -11.25px;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
}
.qty-plus {
    background: #dadada;
    width: 45px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #475569;
    user-select: none;
    clip-path: polygon(25% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
}
.qty-plus:hover {
    background: #e2e8f0;
}

/* Product Card Styling */
.prod-card {
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.prod-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}
/* underline the product name while its card is hovered */
.prod-card:hover .cart-qty-update > a {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
</style>
<script>
// Products pagination. Rendered from window.page_data; window.renderProductPagination() can be called again after an in-place refresh.
(function () {
    let templates = null;

    function pageUrl(page, pageLength) {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.set("page", page);
        url.searchParams.set("page_length", pageLength);
        return url.toString();
    }

    function pageNumbers(current, total) {
        if (total <= 7) {
            return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
        }
        const pages = [1];
        if (current > 3) pages.push("...");
        let start = Math.max(2, current - 1);
        let end = Math.min(total - 1, current + 1);
        if (current <= 3) end = 4;
        if (current >= total - 2) start = total - 3;
        for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) pages.push(i);
        if (current < total - 2) pages.push("...");
        pages.push(total);
        return pages;
    }

    function setNavLink(link, page, enabled, label, pageLength) {
        link.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
        if (enabled) {
            link.href = pageUrl(page, pageLength);
            link.classList.remove("is-disabled");
            link.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
        } else {
            link.removeAttribute("href");
            link.classList.add("is-disabled");
            link.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        }
    }

    function render() {
        const data = window.page_data || {};
        const currentPage = parseInt(data.current_page) || 1;
        const totalPages = parseInt(data.total_pages) || 1;
        const pageLength = parseInt(data.page_length) || 20;
        const container = document.querySelector(".pagination-links");
        if (!container) return;

        if (!templates) {
            if (container.children.length < 3) return;
            // Clone the Builder-styled elements once so the look is preserved on every re-render
            templates = {
                prev: container.children[0].cloneNode(true),
                page: container.children[1].cloneNode(true),
                next: container.children[container.children.length - 1].cloneNode(true)
            };
        }
        container.innerHTML = "";

        const prev = templates.prev.cloneNode(true);
        setNavLink(prev, currentPage - 1, currentPage > 1, "Previous page", pageLength);
        container.appendChild(prev);

        pageNumbers(currentPage, totalPages).forEach((page) => {
            const link = templates.page.cloneNode(true);
            (link.querySelector("p") || link).textContent = page;
            if (page === "...") {
                link.removeAttribute("href");
                link.classList.add("is-ellipsis");
                link.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            } else {
                link.href = pageUrl(page, pageLength);
                link.setAttribute("aria-label", "Page " + page);
                if (page === currentPage) {
                    link.classList.add("is-active");
                    link.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
                }
            }
            container.appendChild(link);
        });

        const next = templates.next.cloneNode(true);
        setNavLink(next, currentPage + 1, currentPage < totalPages, "Next page", pageLength);
        container.appendChild(next);

        const perPage = document.querySelector(".page-length-select");
        if (perPage) perPage.value = String(pageLength);
    }

    window.renderProductPagination = render;
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", render);
})();
</script>
